raw_segments.text: Yes, indeed was he, and he went up to the attics when all was burning above and below,
and got the servants out of their beds and helped them down himself, and went back to
get his mad wife out of her cell.
And then they called out to him that she was on the roof, where she was standing, waving
her arms above the battlements and shouting out till they could hear her a mile off.
I saw her and heard her with my own eyes.
